title: Vector Storm
short_description: Vector Storm: a neon twin-stick arena shooter. Survive the geometry — kite escalating swarms of vector shapes, chain multipliers, and outlast the storm.
description: Vector Storm drops your ship into a pulsing neon arena where the geometry itself hunts you. Kite escalating swarms of vector shapes with twin-stick movement and independent mouse aim, chain score multipliers, grab power-ups, and outlast wave after wave of the storm. Survive the geometry. Outlast the swarm.
controls_keyboard: WASD / left stick — move · Mouse / right stick — aim · LMB — fire · twin-stick arena survival
